Company Overview

About the Company

We at Marudhar Packaging take pride in being one of best corrugated boxes manufacturers in Bangalore. We had a dedicated, efficient & well experienced team for production and quality assurance which helps us to ensure timely delivery and superb quality that meets client expectation as per the requirements. We believe in developing long term relationships with our valued customers, which can only be possible with our understanding of customers requirements and deliver accordingly. Our vast range of products includes Corrugated Carton Boxes, Cardboard box, corrugated gift boxes; Corrugated printed boxes, Corrugated Partition, Corrugated paper rolls Etc.
